q1_issues.issue: (Measure sk_old_1 old 15 year) puts the 15-year age on the reified state witness rather than on Ken, so that atom asserts the state itself is 15 years old.
sk_old_1 gets no class atom, while the reified-state pattern for a copular clause with a time modifier requires (Member sk_<state> <state>) beside the Experiencer atom, leaving the witness untyped.

q2_gaps: a Measure (age) copular clause carrying a temporal modifier — the state-reification pattern that anchors 'Alice was ill on Friday' has no defined shape for a measure predicate, since a measure entails no positive property to name the state class with and the magnitude has no slot on the state witness
notes: The flat tense-wrapped (Future (Measure ken old 15 year)), the deictic constant next_year and the mandatory Name atom are all right; only the reified half is malformed. Reading bare '15' as the old/year age scale follows the instruction set's '30 years old' example.
